var pyw = `
import openpyxl, shutil
src = '/home/user/Desktop/purchase_order_form.xlsx'
shutil.copy(src, '/home/user/po_backup.xlsx')
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(src)
ws = wb.worksheets[0]

# Find first empty row in column A (append after existing purchase details)
row = 2
while ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value not in (None, ''):
    row += 1
print("append at row", row)

approved = [
    ("Sarah Jones", "Canon EOS R5 Kit", "Hardware", "B&H Photo", "$3,899.00", 1, "$3,899.00"),
]
for rec in approved:
    for ci, val in enumerate(rec, start=1):
        ws.cell(row=row, column=ci).value = val
    row += 1

wb.save(src)
print("saved")

wb2 = openpyxl.load_workbook(src)
ws2 = wb2.worksheets[0]
print("sheets:", wb2.sheetnames)
for r in range(1, ws2.max_row+1):
    print(r, [ws2.cell(row=r, column=c).value for c in range(1, 8)])
`;
